risk: Direct overlap with Mission Aware or FDIR literature
mitigation: Frame contribution as policy comparison with mission and trusted-recovery outcomes

risk: Paper becomes a broad satellite cybersecurity survey/testbed
mitigation: Freeze MVP events, states, policies, and primary outcomes

risk: Redistribution violates NOS3 or dataset terms
mitigation: Use upstream pins, manifests, attribution, and no raw third-party data in Git

risk: Simulation is too simplified for mission claims
mitigation: Define architecture and external-validity boundary; use public data for calibration
Use primary outcomes and Pareto analysis; composite only in sensitivity analysis

risk: Trials depend on uncontrolled simulator state
mitigation: Clean snapshots, seeds, immutable logs, pinned versions

risk: Event injection reaches external systems or RF
mitigation: Host-only network, no antennas, ROE, shutdown checks

risk: Interview reuse or operator study occurs without determination
mitigation: Use published findings only until IRB/HRPP determination

risk: Hardware or technical data changes scope
mitigation: Public software/synthetic data only; institutional export review for expansion

risk: Released scripts lower barriers for operational abuse
mitigation: Sanitize artifacts and conduct responsible-release review

risk: NOS3 dependencies fail on Apple Silicon or current macOS
mitigation: Use Linux VM/container and validate architecture before implementation

risk: Operational anomalies are mislabeled as cyberattacks
mitigation: Use ESA/OPS-SAT only for calibration; causal cyber labels come from controlled experiments
